heading: 50/50 Raffle — In Person Only
intro: A separate 50/50 raffle is planned for Lakewood on Friday, November 13. Purchase entries at the event with raffle volunteers. Setup and final rules are being confirmed.

events.announcement: Friday, November 13: Lakewood Civic Auditorium — its own entries, jackpot and winner.
Saturday, November 14: The Piano Guys concert at Akron Civic Theatre. A separate raffle is under consideration, subject to confirmation.
Saturday, November 14: Fairlawn Meet & Greet at St. Hilary Church. A separate raffle is under consideration, subject to confirmation.

closing: Drawing during the Lakewood event on November 13. The precise sales cutoff and announcement time will be confirmed. There is no combined weekend jackpot.
sunday: There will be no raffle at Sunday's November 15 event at Mayfield United Methodist Church.
prize: The planned winner’s share is 50% of gross raffle sales. Processing fees and operating expenses come from the organization’s half.
